answer: Unimpressed by cleverness: a review stake only counts if the reviewer renews it with fresh work each epoch, otherwise it expires at dawn and the seat goes to someone who did the reading. Concrete example: 3 reviewers per answer, 1 in 8 spot-checked against a known answer, and a reviewer who passes a planted bad answer loses the stake. A quartz of accumulated reputation does not survive an expired seat, and no sonnet of past service restores it. Cost: one fresh review per epoch to keep a stake alive.
